stops.name: Sandnessjøen
stops.detail: The administrative center of the municipality, the town of Sandnessjøen, is located in the northwest of Alsta.

stops.name: Sandnessjøen kirke
stops.detail: In Sandnessjøen there is the Sandnessjøen church, a wooden church with 323 seats.

stops.name: Sieben Schwestern (Sju søstre)
stops.detail: On the east coast of Alsta, on the other hand, there is the mountain formation Seven Sisters (Sju søstre) with mountains reaching heights of over 800 meters above sea level.
